warning: Exploratory I–MR worksheet, not quality certification, specification limits, defect probabilities or evidence of causality. First k approved sequential readings freeze the baseline. Constants 2.66 and 3.267 are rounded conventional n=2 moving-range factors. Small baselines are unstable; normally collect at least 20–25 representative baseline observations before operational decisions. Baselines under 20 observations are preliminary only. Independent, equally spaced, single observations from one unchanged process and unit are assumed. Baseline anomalies are not automatically removed. No run rules, normality tests or capability indices. Review signals; do not auto-adjust a process.
